item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Committee recorded that China’s 2012 Criminal Procedure Law amendments prohibited using torture-derived confessions as evidence and required audio or video recording of interrogations in major criminal cases.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical institutional context; enacted before 2023 and not evidence of 2023 implementation.","ruler_attribution":"State-party legislation during Xi Jinping’s tenure, but the document does not attribute the measure personally to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The source reports the legal measure but does not establish nationwide compliance or 2023 outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The Committee recorded that China abolished the re-education-through-labour system of administrative detention in 2014 and fully implemented audiovisual recording throughout interrogations of criminal suspects in major cases.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.9","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical context; the institutional changes predate 2023.","ruler_attribution":"State-party policy during Xi Jinping’s tenure; no personal direction by Xi is shown.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether abolition eliminated comparable administrative detention or whether recording requirements were consistently followed."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that recommendations concerning safeguards against torture, the State Secrets Law, harassment of lawyers, human-rights defenders and petitioners, statistical information, and accountability for events in Tibet had not yet been implemented.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical institutional finding from 2015; relevant as inherited context but not a 2023 observation.","ruler_attribution":"Finding concerns the Chinese State party; the document does not establish Xi Jinping’s personal involvement.","limitations":["The finding predates 2023 and does not show whether any recommendation was later implemented."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Committee found that China’s domestic legal provisions did not include all elements of the Convention definition of torture, including coverage of all public officials and torture for purposes beyond extracting confessions, creating actual or potential loopholes for impunity.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical legal finding from 2015; no 2023 legal change is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Finding concerns Chinese legislation and institutions, not a personal act documented for Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The document does not assess subsequent amendments or 2023 enforcement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that China had not shortened the legal maximum period of police custody of 30 days plus an additional seven days before prosecutorial approval, and noted that prosecutorial authorities disapproved 406 arrests in 2014.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical context; the 406-arrest figure is for 2014, not 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese criminal-justice institutions; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["The disapproved-arrest figure is not evidence of overall detention legality or later practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that investigators could indefinitely withhold lawyer access and family notification in cases involving State secrets, terrorism, serious bribery, or alleged threats to State security, and that detainees lacked access to an independent impartial authority to challenge refusals.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical legal and institutional finding from 2015; not a direct 2023 measurement.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese law and public-security practice; Xi’s personal role is not specified.","limitations":["The source describes reported practice and legal powers without 2023 verification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"The Committee found that residential surveillance at a designated location could last up to six months for certain security, terrorism, or bribery cases, without requiring families to be told the reason or place of detention, creating a risk of secret incommunicado detention and torture.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical legal finding from 2015; the supplied document provides no 2023 update.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese criminal-procedure law and public-security authorities; no personal Xi order is identified.","limitations":["The finding concerns legal design and reported risk rather than a quantified 2023 incidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":12,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported more than 200 lawyers and activists detained or interrogated since 9 July 2015; 25 reportedly remained under residential surveillance at designated locations and four were allegedly unaccounted for.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Specific to 2015 and therefore historical context rather than a 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns State actions during Xi Jinping’s tenure, but does not establish his personal authorization.","limitations":["Figures are reported figures in the Committee’s finding and are not independently verified within the supplied text."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":13,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The Committee found consistent reports that torture and ill-treatment remained deeply entrenched in China’s criminal-justice system, with excessive public-security power during investigations and detention and insufficient prosecutorial and judicial control.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Institutional assessment adopted in 2015; it does not directly establish conditions in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Finding concerns Chinese criminal-justice institutions; no personal Xi conduct is documented.","limitations":["The assessment is based on reports cited by the Committee and lacks a supplied 2023 follow-up."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":19,"end_unit":19,"fact_summary":"The Committee found that China’s use of State-secrecy provisions restricted access to information about torture and criminal justice, and that the State party failed to provide substantial requested data, preventing full assessment of Convention compliance.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.6","7B.1","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical transparency finding from 2015; relevant as institutional context only.","ruler_attribution":"Finding concerns the Chinese State party’s disclosure practices, not a personal Xi statement or decision.","limitations":["The source does not provide 2023 disclosure data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":20,"end_unit":20,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that courts often shifted the burden of proof to defendants during exclusionary procedures and dismissed lawyers’ requests to exclude confessions, while China supplied no statistics on use or outcomes of the exclusionary rule.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical judicial finding from 2015; no 2023 evidence is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese courts and criminal procedure; personal attribution to Xi is not established.","limitations":["The finding reports patterns and missing data rather than a complete national dataset."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":20,"end_unit":20,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that audiovisual recording was not mandatory in all interrogation cases, that recording audits were conducted by public-security legal departments, and that police allegedly selectively recorded interrogations or committed torture outside video surveillance.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.3","3B.4","3B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical implementation finding from 2015; not a direct 2023 observation.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns public-security practice and oversight institutions; Xi’s personal role is not documented.","limitations":["The source does not quantify the prevalence of selective recording or torture."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":22,"end_unit":22,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported consistent allegations that human-rights defenders, lawyers, petitioners, political dissidents, and religious or ethnic minorities were charged or threatened with broadly defined offenses used as intimidation, including offenses related to national security and terrorism.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical finding from 2015; it does not establish the scale or continuation of the practice in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese criminal law and enforcement; no direct personal order by Xi is supplied.","limitations":["The source characterizes allegations and legal scope, not adjudicated responsibility in individual cases."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":23,"end_unit":23,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported credible-source accounts of torture, deaths in custody, arbitrary detention, and disappearances of Tibetans, as well as allegations concerning Uyghurs and Mongolians; China failed to provide information on 24 of 26 Tibetan cases identified by the Committee.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.7","3B.9","4B.3","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical finding from 2015; not a 2023 incident record.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns State conduct toward ethnic minorities; the document does not establish Xi’s personal knowledge or authorization.","limitations":["The source reports allegations and non-disclosure, not final judicial findings for every case."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":24,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported continuing allegations of illegal detention in unofficial facilities known as black jails, and stated that China provided no information on investigations into such facilities or alleged rape and deaths associated with them.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical finding from 2015; the supplied document does not establish whether the practice continued into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns local police and administrative detention practices; no personal Xi direction is shown.","limitations":["The finding is based on reports and missing official information."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":27,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that China forcibly repatriated North Korean nationals and cited more than 100 testimonies indicating that people forcibly returned to North Korea had been systematically subjected to torture and ill-treatment.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.7","3B.9","2B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical cross-border practice identified in 2015; no 2023 case is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese border and repatriation policy; the document does not attribute the policy personally to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The testimonies concern treatment after repatriation and do not establish Chinese officials’ knowledge of each case."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":28,"end_unit":28,"fact_summary":"The Committee welcomed that China ended the death penalty for some economic and non-lethal crimes, but reported that China supplied insufficient data to verify implementation and noted reports of death-row prisoners being shackled 24 hours a day.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.7","7B.7","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical legal and implementation finding from 2015; no 2023 data is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese criminal-justice policy; personal attribution to Xi is not established.","limitations":["The source does not provide execution totals or verify the reported shackling practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":29,"end_unit":29,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that China’s Population and Family Planning Law prohibited coercive measures, but it received reports of coerced sterilization and forced abortions and no information on investigations or redress for those allegations.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical legal-practice finding from 2015; not direct evidence of 2023 conduct.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese population-policy implementation; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["The source records allegations and missing investigation data, not verified incidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":30,"end_unit":30,"fact_summary":"The Committee found that China had not clarified whether excessive-force allegations connected to the 1989 Tiananmen Square suppression had been independently investigated, while noting the State party’s position that the suppression was necessary and correct.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical inherited context; the event predates Xi’s leadership and is not a 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The Committee described the State party’s position; it did not attribute the 1989 decision to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["This is not evidence of Xi’s personal conduct in 2023, but of unresolved institutional accountability."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":31,"end_unit":31,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported that private and public clinics offered so-called conversion therapy, including electroshocks and sometimes involuntary confinement, and that China had not clarified whether such practices were prohibited, investigated, ended, or remedied.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.8","6B.8","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical finding from 2015; no 2023 implementation evidence is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese health and legal institutions; no personal Xi policy is documented.","limitations":["The source notes a 2014 compensation ruling but does not establish nationwide prevalence or official authorization."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":33,"end_unit":33,"fact_summary":"The Committee noted that China’s State Compensation Law allowed awards for psychological harm, but claims against the State were generally statute-barred two years after the plaintiff knew or should have known of the damage, and no formal proactive rehabilitation mechanism was documented.","question_ids":["3B.4","6B.2","6B.8","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical legal finding from 2015; not a 2023 welfare or remedy outcome.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese compensation law and rehabilitation arrangements; personal attribution to Xi is not established.","limitations":["The source does not quantify compensation awards or access to rehabilitation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-64a3cea59d848507","start_unit":34,"end_unit":34,"fact_summary":"The Committee reported insufficient information on the proportion of officials trained on the Convention and the effect of training on torture prevention, and called for compulsory periodic training and evaluation of its effectiveness.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.7","8B.4","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical administrative-capacity finding from 2015; no 2023 training data is supplied.","ruler_attribution":"Concerns Chinese official training systems; Xi’s personal appointment or direction is not documented.","limitations":["The finding is about missing evidence and does not prove that no training occurred."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is a 2015 United Nations Committee against Torture concluding-observations document, despite the target period being 2023-2023; all facts therefore function as historical institutional context rather than direct 2023 observations.","The extracted text contains encoding artifacts, but the cited units are sufficiently legible for the identified facts.","The document concerns China’s State party and institutions; it generally does not establish Xi Jinping’s personal authorization, knowledge, or responsibility for each finding."]}
